sources: Oh My Darling, Clementine — American ballad, published 1884 (Percy Montrose); public domain. Sung in Chinese as 新年好
notes: F major, range C4-C5. The dotted-eighth + sixteenth pickups of the printed song are written as even eighths (no sixteenths at this level). Written out from memory in the simplest form; no network in the build environment, so not compared against an online score. Needs a listen by a person.
